build.flags: -g -DUNIX (makefile.unix MODE, no optimisation); FLOAT is float under UNIX
build.sources: A: harness.c l3psy_probe.c; B: harness_mapping.c l3psy_mapping_probe.c; both with common.c subs.c psy.c tonal.c portableio.c ieeefloat.c -lm

probe.description: observation-only patch: copies en[sb]/thm[sb] after the long-block scale-factor loop and flags whether that path ran; no arithmetic change
probe.label: probe A, encoder-path capture (expected/)

probe_long_fft.base: l3psy_mapping_probe.c (probe B) and the original subs.c
probe_long_fft.captured: 2026-11-12, fresh extraction of the pinned archive, same container and toolchain as probes A and B
probe_long_fft.description: copies window[0..1023] and wsamp_r[0..1023] before the Layer III long fft() call and energy[]/phi[] after it (l3psy.c around original l. 483); inside subs.c fft(), while armed by that call only, copies each energy[i]/energy[ip] right after it is computed and before the 0.0005 floor test, and applies the same bit-reversal swap to that copy; writes only probe globals and block-local counters
probe_long_fft.flags: -g -DUNIX (makefile.unix MODE, no optimisation); FLOAT is float
probe_long_fft.label: probe C, long-FFT probe (expected_long_fft/); observation-only, built on probe B
probe_long_fft.repeatability: two container runs byte-identical (all outputs, window files and the binary)
probe_long_fft.sources: harness_fft.c l3psy_fft_probe.c subs_fft_probe.c common.c psy.c tonal.c portableio.c ieeefloat.c -lm
probe_long_fft.stdout_filter: only lines starting with '{' kept (drops the absthr index status line)
probe_long_fft.unselected_outputs_note: inputs without selected calls; their probe C output is byte-identical to probe B's and is not stored again
probe_long_fft.window_note: written by every one of the nine runs; all nine files were byte-identical, one copy is kept

probe_long_mapping.description: observation-only patch: records temp_1 = min(nb, 2 nb_1, 16 nb_2) per partition and, before the block-switching branch of every call, applies the encoder's long-band mapping (l3psy.c ll. 654-660 expressions and summation order) to eb, thr, qthr_l, temp_1 and to thr restricted to partitions where qthr_l >= temp_1; writes no encoder variable
probe_long_mapping.label: probe B, long-band mapping probe (expected_long_mapping/); a project extension, not encoder behaviour

reference.description: ISO MPEG Audio Subgroup Software Simulation Group (1996), MPEG-2 Audio Simulation Software Distribution 10 (dist10), lsf/encoder, L3psycho_anal (psychoacoustic model 2, Layer III form)
reference.licence: no licence file in the repository; the sources carry ISO 1996 headers only
reference.note: the cleaned repository master l3psy.c is byte-identical to the archive's lsf/encoder/l3psy.c (checked 2026-11-11)

read_only_sources_sha256.note: read only (final-frame zero fill, encode.c ll. 160-162); not compiled

run.call: each call passes 576 new samples; the 1344-sample save buffer starts zeroed (as musicin.c memsets sam)
run.captured: 2026-11-11 (probe A, first 7 inputs); 2026-11-11 recapture of A and B from a fresh extraction
run.channel: mono stream as chn 0; one process per signal, so no static state is shared between signals
run.final_partial_granule: A rejects clips that are not whole 1152-sample frames and is run only on those; B fills a final partial granule with zeros like encode.c
run.repeatability: first capture: two runs byte-identical. Recapture: two further runs byte-identical (outputs and both binaries); probe A outputs and harness binary byte-identical to the first capture
run.stdout_filter: library status lines (absthr index print) dropped; only lines starting with '{' kept
